subject: english
stem:
At first, few students used the reading room after school. The library added group tables and kept the room open later. By spring, every table was busy each afternoon.
Which choice is the best answer?
options: Library changes increased use of the reading room

optionRationales.reason: Library changes increased use of the reading room：開頭的少人使用與結尾的滿座由中段兩項改變連接。
The library added group tables：只保留中段一項方法。
All students everywhere prefer libraries：原文只談一校 reading room。
Spring made the tables smaller：spring 只是結果時間，沒有桌子變小。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「開頭設定的問題或主題與結尾給出的結果互相呼應」可推出 Library changes increased use of the reading room；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Library changes increased use of the reading room 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
